name: How long does a walk-in shower installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a walk-in shower installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a walk-in shower installation depends on the project's complexity and whether it's part of a larger bathroom remodel. A straightforward replacement of an existing shower or tub can often be completed within 3-5 days. However, projects involving extensive tile work, custom designs, significant plumbing alterations, or structural changes may take 1-2 weeks or more. We aim to minimize disruption and provide a clear timeline upfront.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies: 3-5 days for simple replacements, 1-2 weeks or more for complex projects with extensive modifications. We provide a clear timeline.
